# Figure 6: data and code

This document loads **all numeric source data supplied for this figure** and produces descriptive plotting previews. The CSV files are preserved exactly as provided. These graphics are **not a pixel-perfect reconstruction** of the manuscript PDF: layouts, statistical significance annotations, Western blots, microscopy images, schematics, and other image-based panels require separate source materials.

**Statistical caution:** No between-group tests, multiplicity corrections, significance stars, binding-affinity fits, or other undocumented inferential procedures are invented here. The plots show observed values or descriptive mean ± SD/SEM as labelled.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = TRUE, message = FALSE,
                       fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5.5, dpi = 150)
source("../script/source_data_helpers.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
```

This figure has **13 CSV source-data files**. The original figure PDF is `Figure 6.pdf` when included in the full archive.

## Panel C

### Fig6C / Weight / IQGAP2

Source file: `Fig6C_Weight_IQGAP2.csv`.

```{r Fig6C-Weight-IQGAP2, fig.cap="Fig6C_Weight_IQGAP2: descriptive plot from supplied source data"}
data <- read_source_csv("Fig6C_Weight_IQGAP2.csv")
knitr::kable(source_summary(data), caption = "Source CSV completeness check")
print(plot_source_data(data, "Fig6C_Weight_IQGAP2.csv"))
```
